notes: Molde's trademarks on the waterfront and in the centre: Aker Stadion (Kjell Kosberg, 1998), Molde FK's ground on the fjord shore at Reknes, a continuous two-tier bowl with rounded corners under a dark grey curved roof, granite and glass facade, blue seats; Scandic Seilet (Kosberg, 2002), the 16-storey glass hotel shaped like a sail on piles in the fjord, its mast at the prow (82 m with the mast); Molde domkirke (Finn Bryn, 1957), a white concrete long church with a steep red tile roof and its free-standing 50 m white campanile with a copper pyramid spire and clock gables.
